description: The counter-example to document-level searchable detection. The page carries 1,277 characters of headings, disclaimers and navigation, while the entire table is a single raster image covering 45% of the page with effectively no text inside it. Read via OCR; every resulting row is routed to human review rather than auto-accepted. Titled 'Balance of Bids/Excess Funds' but publishes no per-row amount, so surplus is correctly absent.
